## Why This Is Asked

- Short-lived per-device certificates

## Code Example

```javascript
// PseudoEnrollment: validate token, request cert, store securely
async function enrollDriver(token, region) {
  if (!validateToken(token)) throw new Error('Invalid token')
  const cert = await requestCert(token, region)
  await storeCertificate(cert)
  return cert
}
```

## Why This Is Asked
This explores KCA for highly ephemeral, autoscaled compute—focus on speed, granularity, and revocation in the face of massive churn.

## Key Concepts
- Ephemeral workload attestation
- Per-function SPIFFE ID and scope
- Short-lived TLS certs with PQC agility
- Online/offline revocation and audit trails

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudocode: CSR envelope for a function
function prepareCsr(functionId, region, service){
  const spiffe = `spiffe://kca/functions/${region}/${service}/${functionId}`;
  return { spiffe, ttl: 120, scope: 'function' };
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
